text: Working on it: bug in dateutil/relativedelta.py (float handling, testAdditionFloatValue).
Got it: bug in dateutil/rrule.py (count=0 handling, testCountZero).
Noted: rrule.py bug for testStrAppendRRULEToken. Investigating now.
Noted: parser.py bug for testFuzzyWithTokens. Investigating now.
Understood — request #4 (parser.py fuzzy_with_tokens) is intended behaviour. I made no changes for it, so nothing to undo; parser.py is untouched.
Done — no change was made for #1, so relativedelta.py is untouched and keeps its old behaviour.
Noted: parser.py bug for test_idx_check. Investigating now.
Noted: relativedelta.py bug for testAbsoluteAddition. Investigating now.

Fixed: rrule(count=0) now yields an empty sequence instead of an unbounded stream (count handling in rrule._iter decrements before yielding and stops when count < 0, in both the bysetpos and normal branches). Verified: list(rrule(DAILY,count=0,dtstart=...)) == [] and the full suite is unchanged (1064 passed, 43 skipped).

Fixed: rrule.__str__ now emits the RFC 5545 "RRULE:" token, so str(rrule(YEARLY,count=3,dtstart=datetime(1997,9,2,9,0))) == 'DTSTART:19970902T090000\nRRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=3'. Verified; full suite unchanged (1064 passed, 43 skipped).

Fixed: in parser._parse the "X h MM or X m SS" branch had its `elif idx == 2:` block wrongly nested inside `if idx == 1:` (unreachable); it is now a sibling, so e.g. parse('10 m 30') correctly yields minute=10, second=30. Verified; full suite unchanged (1064 passed, 43 skipped).

Still working on #8 (relativedelta absolute addition / testAbsoluteAddition). The absolute-value path in __add__ and __init__ looks correct on inspection so far; I am running a behaviour matrix to pin down the wrong case.
